description: This source file implements the MediaPlayerManager class, which manages media player clients, including attaching, detaching, and controlling media player instances, with thread safety mechanisms and integration with GStreamer objects.

classes.name: MediaPlayerManager
classes.description: Manages media player clients, handles their lifecycle, and controls access to media playback resources.

classes.name: MediaPlayerClientInfo
classes.description: Holds information about a media player client, including the client object, controller, and reference count.

methods.name: MediaPlayerManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the current GStreamer bin parent to nullptr.

methods.name: ~MediaPlayerManager
methods.description: Destructor that releases the media player client.

methods.name: attachMediaPlayerClient
methods.description: Attaches a media player client to a specified GStreamer object, creating a new client if necessary.

methods.name: getMediaPlayerClient
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the current media player client.

methods.name: hasControl
methods.description: Checks if the manager has control over the current media player client.

methods.name: releaseMediaPlayerClient
methods.description: Releases the current media player client, updating reference counts and cleaning up.

methods.name: acquireControl
methods.description: Attempts to acquire control of a media player client if no controller exists.

methods.name: createMediaPlayerClient
methods.description: Creates and registers a new media player client associated with a GStreamer object.
